title: Toronto Harbour Cruises

services.name: Cruise Dates
services.desc: As a rule, we do follow the cruise route as shown. However, there may be occasions when the captain makes the decision to alter the route of your cruise. The route taken is totally at the discretion of the captain, who will make this decision based upon your safety and to ensure that you derive maximum enjoyment from your experience with us. There will be no refunds issued in the event that your cruise is rerouted for any reason. Should the captain deem it advisable to remain at the dock due to weather creating dangerous conditions, this would not result in any reduction or refund of the ticket/s
